title: 有機化学Ⅱ
subtitle: Organic Chemistry II
keywords: Classification and nomenclature of organic compounds
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1)structures, properties, classification and nomenclature of organic compounds
(2)various organic reactions
(3)the basis of stereochemistry
(4)the basis of organic electron theory
advice: Organic chemistry is very important for the pharmaceutical, food, and chemical industries. In this course, structures, classification, nomenclature, and reactions of various organic compounds will be lectured. Organic reactions will be understood through stereochemistry and organic electron theory.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

                 Organic chemistry is very important for the pharmaceutical, food, and chemical industries. In this course, structures, classification, nomenclature, and reactions of various organic compounds will be lectured. Organic reactions will be understood through stereochemistry and organic electron theory.
